criteria.requirement: Fix Functions._type_check so every actual variadic argument uses the final signature rule after the fixed prefix. Preserve arity validation, array subtype checking, untyped variadic rules and custom function dispatch. Invalid later values must raise JMESPathTypeError before calling the function body, with actual function/type context; do not rely on uncontrolled Python exceptions from merge or custom functions. Fixed-arity behavior and all language semantics remain compatible.
